scenes.text: Imagine walking into your bedroom in Victorian London, feeling completely safe, unaware that your beautiful green walls are slowly poisoning you.
The key ingredient making that brilliant green shine was arsenic.
When these rooms got damp, a toxic fungus reacted with the wallpaper, releasing a lethal, odorless gas directly into the air.
It took years for people to realize their trendy bedrooms were actually elegant death traps.
